review_candidates.description: Overview Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted. The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues. The Acquisition and Technology Analysis Group within JOID specializes in the application of multi-disciplinary analytic skills to support multiple clients within the Department of Defense (DoD). These clients include the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering (OUSD(R&E)), Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment (OUSD(A&S)), DARPA, the Joint Staff, and USINDOPACOM. SPA provides critical decision support to enabling and executing a strategy of technological superiority and enabling the delivery and sustainment of secure, resilient, and preeminent capabilities to the warfighter quickly and cost effectively. Our team of experienced military, technical, and operations research analysts is skilled in evaluating military problems, identifying the driving factors, devising innovative approaches, collecting applicable data, developing necessary software tools, and performing thorough and timely assessments to inform technology and acquisition governance decisions to ensure U.S. military forces retain military superiority in the future. We have an immediate need for a Sr. Technical Writer to provide onsite support out of the Mark Center. Responsibilities The Sr. Technical Writer will provide expert research, writing, editing, and multimedia communication support. Apply mastery-level capability in developing clear, compelling, and visually engaging communication products tailored to senior-level audiences. Produce high-quality speeches, presentations, reports, and communication products across multiple formats and platforms, including formal briefs, PowerPoint decks, multimedia content, blogs, videos, articles, op-eds, and social media posts. Apply mastery-level skills in Microsoft Office, particularly MS PowerPoint, MS Word, MS Excel, and related multimedia applications to design and deliver senior-level briefings, data-driven presentations, and visually compelling products. Research emerging technical issues, trends, and organizational priorities; distill complex subject matter into clear, plain-English narratives suitable for senior leaders, interagency partners, Congress, and public-facing audiences. Develop communications tailored to diverse audiences, including government executives, internal personnel, industry, academia, media, and public stakeholders; align all messaging to OUSD(R&E) strategic communications plans. Collaborate routinely with clients and senior officials to refine messaging, review drafts, develop talking points, and plan communication strategies. Lead creation of dynamic, visually engaging multimedia products that incorporate graphics, video elements, templates, charts, and other digital tools to enhance message clarity and impact. Manage content development from initial research through final production; track issues, coordinate speaking engagements, and oversee logistics for presentations and associated materials. Produce social media content, manage communication strategies, and craft messages tailored for digital platforms in alignment with DoD public affairs and OUSD(R&E) communication guidelines. Ensure all written and multimedia materials meet DoD standards for accuracy, grammar, format, and quality; deliver polished products under tight deadlines in fast-paced senior executive environments. Coordinate with workflow managers, technical SMEs, and front office staff to integrate content, maintain situational awareness of ongoing initiatives, and ensure alignment with enterprise priorities. Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, Communications, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in communications, public affairs, or journalism including high-tempo, senior-level DoD or Service Headquarters environments. Demonstrated proficiency in MS Office, especially expert-level PowerPoint presentation design, document formatting, and multimedia integration. Proven ability to write clearly, concisely, and compellingly for senior leaders; ability to manage multiple projects independently and prioritize effectively. Experience developing and executing social media communication strategies. Ability to communicate complex technical topics in plain English tailored to multiple audiences. Strong organizational skills, critical thinking, and attention to detail; ability to meet deadlines. Active TS/SCI clearance. Able to work fully onsite. Desired Graduate degree. Experience supporting communications for a technical or research organization. Experience developing multi-format content aligned with senior-level DoD strategic messaging. Experience coordinating with senior officials and front offices in fast-paced operational environments. Pay Range Information At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Virginia, Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $115,000.00/Yr. - USD $135,000.00/Yr.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Category Specialist
review_candidates.description: JOB TITLE Sr. Category Specialist | MAF Global Solutions | Global Solutions Egypt Role Summary The role of the Senior Sourcing Specialist is to support the FM procurement category through strategic and operational procurement activities supporting various FM projects ROLE PROFILE Strategic & Operational Procurement: Lead procurement activities across FM categories, supporting projects and managing approximately AED 50–100M annual spend. Sourcing & Procurement Strategy: Develop and implement sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives, legal requirements, internal policies, and procurement best practices. Tendering & Negotiation: Manage RFQs/RFPs, bidding, eSourcing and eAuctions, supplier negotiations, and finalization of contracts/LOIs. Cost & Savings Management: Analyze supplier proposals, conduct TCO and costing analysis, negotiate competitive pricing, and track annual savings against targets. Supplier Management: Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage suppliers while monitoring supplier performance and developing strategic supplier relationships. Market & Category Analysis: Conduct market research, benchmarking, supply-market analysis, and monitor market trends to identify opportunities and improve category performance. Stakeholder & Governance Management: Collaborate with internal business clients and procurement teams while ensuring compliance, governance, and effective procurement processes. Reporting & Process Improvement: Report sourcing strategies, recommendations, outcomes, and benefits to management while continuously improving procurement processes and governance. Requirements Procurement Expertise: Strong understanding and practical application of best-in-class procurement processes, systems, and practices, with knowledge of SAP Ariba, Microsoft AX, Oracle, and eRFx. Business Partnering & Negotiation: Customer-focused with strong stakeholder management, influencing, relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong conceptual, analytical, planning, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with sound judgment, integrity, and professionalism. Experience: Minimum 3 years’ experience in contracting or category management, with the ability to drive continuous improvement and organizational change. Education & Professional Qualification: Bachelor’s degree preferred, along with a professional procurement qualification such as MCIPS. Procurement Systems & Best Practices: Strong understanding and practical application of best-in-class procurement processes, systems, policies, and industry practices. What We Offer At Majid Al Futtaim, we’re on a mission to create great moments, to spread happiness, to build, experiences that stay in our memories for a lifetime. We’re proud to say that over the past 27 years, we have built a reputation as a regional market leader in what we do. Join us! Work in a friendly environment, where everyone shares positive vibes and excited about our future. Work with over 45,000 diverse and talented colleagues, all guided by our Leadership Model.
